name: Cá húi
summary: Cá húi is printed on the same line as cá song at Bảo Ngọc, 249 đường 1/4, and on the same kind of line at Mỹ Ngọc and Quang Tùng, on the 20 June 2013 board. The board does not say it is cá song.
howToEat: Order it by weight, on that shared line. The cooking method is not given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường 1/4. A current door is Check on arrival.
